sql: with f as (select distinct lo.market_ticker, lo.limit_price from live_orders lo where lo.strategy='Dmmsell10' and lo.action='buy' and lo.status='filled'), s as (select split_part(f.market_ticker,'-',1) as series, f.limit_price, (select coalesce(p.quantity_fp,p.quantity) from positions p where p.market_ticker=f.market_ticker order by p.captured_at desc limit 1) as qty, (select p.realized_pnl from positions p where p.market_ticker=f.market_ticker order by p.captured_at desc limit 1) as realized from f) select series, count(*) as filled, count(*) filter (where abs(coalesce(qty,1))<=0.01) as settled, count(*) filter (where abs(coalesce(qty,1))<=0.01 and coalesce(realized,0)>0) as wins, count(*) filter (where coalesce(realized,0)<0) as losses, round(sum(coalesce(realized,0))::numeric,2) as realized_usd, round(avg(limit_price)::numeric,1) as avg_entry_px from s group by series order by realized_usd asc
